text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooooh...!! Fine Motiooooon~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, isn't it? Every single one 
of those cheers is for you, Fine-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well... can't be helped today, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Scarlett-chan...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...That was so much fun. It feels kind of 
magical, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When you hone your senses, you can kind of 
tell what kind of mindset everyone's 
running with, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So... Fine-san, you must be feeling so 
refreshed and bright right now, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I gave it everything I had in my own 
way.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Geez. When you smile like that, 
how can I say anything?
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is waiting for you! Go get 
'em.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yup, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful. We've reached such a 
magnificent view—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Shakur, thank you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wonder. Putting it into words 
doesn't feel very smart, does it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I do like how decisive you are. Though, 
could I hold on to what you just said for 
later?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
... I haven't put it behind me, not by a 
long shot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Because I knew it right from the start. 
This is where it ends for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's borin' as hell. I've been 
lookin' for somethin' that can twist the 
ending out of shape.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when you caught my eye... Fine. 
At first, I was just analyzing your data 
because you were different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet on that day, you defied all 
predictions. At that exact moment... the 
thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone can rewrite a predetermined 
fate... maybe it's this one?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I change your ending—if I keep you 
running, the premise collapses, and my 
ending should change too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I decided to believe that hypothesis... I 
foolishly clung to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And in the end... my run wasn't enough to 
change the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, not even this result will 
make you give up, will it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because right after the race ended, your 
mind was already working at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I called out to you, you had that 
side profile I love so much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Confronting my loneliness, running while 
wishing they wouldn't forget me... I 
learned something from it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's proof that laying your feelings bare 
like that... will reach the other person's 
heart all the more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I did what I needed to do for myself. What 
about you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...An annoying pest like you should just 
get lost already."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Farewell—

"After this, a press conference was 
arranged for her to announce her return to 
Japan."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm fine. ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so blessed, aren't I? I really, truly 
am such a lucky girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I ran so much, made friends, and received 
so much wonderful cheering."
choice_data_list:
No one will ever forget the impact you 
made.

No one will ever forget the shock you 
delivered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm sure they won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that we can become a sparkling 
memory—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-chan! Don't quit! Please stay in 
racing!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, my blissful 
three years are coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This beautiful ending was decided from the 
very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Races begin, and then they end. Yet, 
within our memories, they transcend 
victory and defeat..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone remembers me, my 
feelings will live on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please... keep Fine Motion in your heart, 
okay?

As she smiled, her eyes sparkled brighter 
than ever before—
